long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as a bank clerk, Kurt Zech entered a construction business begun by his grandfather and rebuilt in Bremen by the family after the war. He took over in 1978 with a partner when it was still a small craft operation. The inherited platform supplied the starting asset; the scale and structure that followed were largely his work.

Zech widened the contractor into a group through regional expansion, company formation and repeated acquisitions. Real-estate development was gathered under a dedicated subsidiary, while hotel development and operation became a third pillar alongside building. In 2020, the businesses were reorganised under Zech Group SE, a strategic management holding that coordinates Building, Real Estate and Hotel divisions. Zech remains chairman of the executive board and a managing shareholder. The family ownership interest underpins his wealth, but the group's development projects, hotels, cash and other corporate assets belong to its companies rather than to him personally.

Kurt Zech inherited the small operating platform in 1978 and transformed it; he is therefore an inherited operator, not the original founder of Zech Group's business lineage.

The current group spans construction, real-estate development and hotels, all organised around the property value chain.
